title: Project directory gets its categories back
summary:
A small cleanup day: the project directory’s categories and names were corrected, and the README gained an assessment badge.

The site’s project list now includes the creative apps and tools/interfaces categories used by the featured-project organizer. KoboldAI Lite has its correct name, and project names no longer carry manually added new-item markers.

An MseeP.ai security assessment badge was added above the README title, linking to its pollinations listing. No application code or security fix was part of the change.
